rationale: No tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/AIObservability/ directory exists and no existing spec covers AI Observability (grep for 'aiObservability|aiExperiment' returns only web Vitest unit specs under web/src/**, no Playwright coverage). The feature is a brand-new enterprise area (dedicated /ai/* rail: llmInsights, sessions, playground, experiments, remoteTasks) distinct from Logs/Metrics/Traces. A new spec file under a new AIObservability area folder is required; because the matrix manifests contain no AIObservability shard, the Engineer must also add a new shard to ci_matrix.ent.json (enterprise) and register the spec there.
